items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about Mac Ferrer; the name is introduced by the interviewer as a topic for the interviewee to know.

ctx.x: Yeah, we knew Lawrence and this was Bill John. Yeah, but now Lawrence is one of the guys that... That's my son. How are you?
Mac Ferrer, who's that? Bill Russell. This is Bill Russell. Please know him.
Talking about old time music with your father. Getting some of the history down. You were talking about the other banjo players.
